decisions.reason: The ID Vault builds directly on the firm's digital identity and secure storage expertise, so it can interpret early results and refine the feature within its super-app platform.
The identity-bound wallet fits the firm's identity and payment capabilities, but its limited website presence and overlap with the payment framework make it a candidate for consolidation.
The NFC login authenticator extends the firm's core authentication knowledge, though as a hardware-adjacent niche product with only a website mention it is somewhat more at risk.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and draws on the firm's integrated payment and security know-how, so management can learn from it and improve it.
The multi-service mobile app platform is the core of the firm's super-app strategy and rests on its decades of related knowledge.
The application shielding library has its own page and sits directly within the firm's long-standing application-security and patented technology base.
